rich_message.text: Alberta taps U of C to study economic impacts of separation
The University of Calgary's School of Public Policy will write the report after which a separate advisory panel will review the findings and deliver its own report

" In a Friday news release, the provincial government says it is important for Albertans to have “objective, evidence-based analysis” ahead of the Oct. 19 referendum where they’ll be asked if the province should stay in Canada or if a second, binding referendum should be held on secession. "
" The province has also appointed a separate advisory panel that it says will provide input to both the university and the government throughout the process. "

" It is concerning to think the premier hadn’t previously asked this question,” he said. “Our province’s and country’s future is being put on the line with this referendum. " and all due to a fence sitter who is fighting for her job rather then her country.
